stem: The value, in dollars, of a collectible stamp \(t\) years after it was bought is modeled by \(V(t) = 1{,}500(1.08)^{t}\). According to the model, the value of the stamp increases by \(p\%\) each year. What is the value of \(p\)?
solution: The base \(1.08 = 1 + 0.08\) is the yearly growth factor.
An increase of \(0.08\) of the value is an increase of \(8\%\), so \(p = 8\).
verify:
t = symbols('t')
V = Lambda(t, 1500*Rational(108, 100)**t)
p = (V(1) / V(0) - 1) * 100
assert p == 8
assert [Rational(s) for s in spr_answers] == [p]
